description.en: Bundles that connect local agent tools to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把本机 Agent 工具接入 DeepSeek Harness 的插件。

description.en: Use local ACP CLI agents (CodeBuddy, DevEco, Qoder, Kiro and others) as model providers; their models appear in the picker as <provider>/<model>. Includes the ACP console for status, models, TPS, token usage and one-click CLI setup.
description.zh: 把本机的 ACP CLI 代理（CodeBuddy、DevEco、Qoder、Kiro 等）作为模型提供方使用，它们的模型以 <provider>/<model> 出现在模型选择器里。自带 ACP 控制台，可查看状态、模型、TPS、Token 用量，并一键接入本机 CLI。
